atoms.a: Entschuldigung. Kannst du mir den Weg zum Kino beschreiben?
atoms.b: Excuse me. ((++Can_you_tell_me_the_way Can_you_give_me)) to the cinema?
atoms.sound: Excuse me. Can you tell me the way to the cinema?

atoms.a: Das Kino ist weit weg. Zuerst musst du geradeaus laufen. Am Ende der Straße musst du rechts abbiegen.
atoms.b: The cinema is far away. First, you have to go ((++straight_on walk_past)). ((++At_the_end_of_the_street At_the_corner)) you have to turn ((++right left)).
atoms.sound: The cinema is far away. First you have to go straight on. At the end of the street you have to turn right.

atoms.a: Dann musst du am Park vorbeilaufen. Und du musst die Straße überqueren und links abbiegen. Das wars.
atoms.b: Then you have to ((++walk_past straight_on)) the park. And you have to ((++cross left)) the street and turn ((++left right)). That's it.
atoms.sound: Then you have to walk past the park. And you have to cross the street and turn left. That's it.
